name: manual_1cb507
claim: A reply that says fixed in commit X goes stale when a later commit supersedes X's approach. Check the code at the current tip, not only that X exists and is an ancestor; post a follow-up reply citing the final fixing commit and leave the earlier reply untouched.

decisions.notes: Two review replies cited a commit whose approach was later removed; the final fixes were in a later commit.

rationale: Two review replies cited a commit whose approach was later removed; the final fixes were in a later commit.
